title: Drive Radio — August 5, 2026
description:
Today's stories:
- Xbox goes down, taking disc-based games with it: A widespread Xbox outage reminded everyone that even the games you own on physical disc can be held hostage by a server hiccup. (https://birchtree.me/blog/xbox-goes-down-you-cant-play-games-you-own-on-disc/)
- Texas halts data center grid connections: The state that branded itself the AI epicenter is now pumping the brakes on new data centers because the power grid can't keep up. (https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/08/texas-halts-data-center-connections-to-power-grid-amid-overwhelming-demand/)
- SpaceX made more money as an AI company than a space company: SpaceX's first earnings call as a public company revealed its AI compute business now outearns its rockets and satellites. (https://www.theverge.com/science/975335/spacex-made-more-money-as-a-neocloud)
- Telegram pulled from the App Store over planted CSAM: Telegram's CEO says an extortionist planted illegal content to get the app yanked, raising thorny questions about app store takedown policy. (https://www.theverge.com/tech/975300/telegram-app-store-takedown-extortion-pavel-durov)
- AI now fuels more than half of cybercrime in Africa, says Interpol: A sobering look at how generative AI is supercharging scams across the continent. (https://www.africanews.com/2026/08/04/ai-fuels-more-than-half-of-cybercrime-in-africa-as-digital-scams-surge-interpol/)
- In Memory of My Wife, Elise Cawley: Stephen Wolfram's deeply personal tribute to his late wife struck a huge chord on Hacker News this week. (https://writings.stephenwolfram.com/2026/08/in-memory-of-my-wife-elise-cawley-1961-2026-with-thanks-for-36-wonderful-years/)
